items.title: Pay hearing-aid co-payment invoice
items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: This is a company invoice, not an authority letter, so there is no statutory deemed-delivery rule; the period runs from the invoice date itself (Rechnungsdatum), 2026-11-19 (Thu). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the event (19 Nov) is not counted, so counting starts 2026-11-20. Adding 30 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on 2026-12-19, a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, when the last day of a period for a declaration or payment falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it shifts to the next business day: Monday 2026-12-21. No NW public holiday falls in this window, so the shift is purely due to the weekend.

warnings: The sender and recipient names/addresses (e.g. 'Mustergießen', 'Beispielwetzlar', 'Musterbank AG') read like placeholder/template values rather than a real company and client — worth double-checking that this is a genuine invoice from your actual hearing-aid provider before paying.

The IBAN DE36 3705 0198 0005 5277 00 is formally valid (passes the checksum check), but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; confirm it matches the account you have used before or verify it independently with the provider before transferring money.
The letter offers 'Ratenzahlung ... nach Absprache' (installment payment by arrangement) — if you want this, confirm and document the arrangement with the provider in writing before the due date.
